subject: 1/ output and input text on the same object and 2/ create hidden object

messages.subject: 1/ output and input text on the same object and 2/ create hidden object
parts:
Hi, I would like store an information on a page using output$xxx when an actionButton is pressed and after read this information if this button is pressed again.

Here is a little script.
This first time the Go button is pressed, a file is created and the filename is stored in filename object.
If I press again, I cannot read what was stored previously. It is always null.

Is there a solution to do that ?

Another question:
It is possible to create invisible zone for storing text ?

Thanks a lot

Marc


shinyApp(
  ui = basicPage(actionButton("go", "Go"), 
                 uiOutput("out"),
                 uiOutput("filename")
                 ),
  
  
  server = function(input, output, session) {
    
    # Check if Go button is clicked
    observeEvent(input$go, {
      # read the content of the filename uiOutput
      interm <- input$filename
      # If something is present, then show it
      if (!is.null(interm)) {
        output$out <- renderText({interm})
      } else {
        output$out <- renderText({"Nothing in input$filename"})
      }
      
      # generate a random name file
      tp <- tempfile(tmpdir=".", fileext = ".Rdata")
      result <- c("My result")
      save(result, file=tp)
      # put the name file in filename
      output$filename <- renderText({
        paste("input$filename is", tp)
      })
      }
      )
  }
)
